title: External Sync + Intelligence Fabric
brief: Connect the live shop system to E2, accounting, offline devices, and intelligence pipelines so PRISM becomes a durable bidirectional operating fabric rather than an isolated frontend shell.

phases.title: Connectors + Analytics Backbone
phases.description: Build sync, offline-queue, and analytics engines that keep PRISM aligned with ERP and financial systems while preserving live operational state.

units.title: E2 shop + accounting sync engines
entry_conditions: Canonical shop-domain and workflow contracts are stable enough to map externally.
E2 and accounting sync boundaries plus ownership rules are documented.
exit_conditions: Bidirectional E2 synchronization exists for jobs, labor, routing, and status snapshots.
Accounting sync exists for actual cost, labor, and operational-finance rollups.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Disable the new connectors and fall back to manual or one-way exports if sync correctness is not ready.

steps.instruction: Build an E2 connector that maps PRISM canonical shop entities to ERP records with provenance and conflict metadata.
Build accounting sync logic for labor, cost, variance, and work-in-process rollups with retry-safe writes.
steps.validation: ERP and accounting payloads can round-trip without losing canonical job, operation, or employee identity.

deliverables.description: Bidirectional sync engine between PRISM shop state and E2 ERP records.
Operational-finance sync engine for actual cost, labor, and variance data.

units.description: E2 shop + accounting sync engines — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Shop analytics + offline queue engines
entry_conditions: External sync edges are defined and conflict semantics are known.
Operational analytics consumers and offline device requirements are documented.
exit_conditions: A shop analytics engine turns live execution data into quote variance, throughput, downtime, and ROI signals.
An offline queue engine can buffer mobile or station mutations until connectivity resumes.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Disable the analytics and offline queue engines and continue with online-only mutations if necessary.

steps.instruction: Build a shop analytics engine that fuses labor, quantity, route, shortage, and approval data into business intelligence signals.
Add an offline change queue with replay, dedupe, and conflict markers for mobile-first shop-floor flows.
steps.validation: Offline mutations can replay safely without double-posting labor or traveler state.

deliverables.description: Business intelligence engine for quote variance, ROI, throughput, and efficiency signals.
Offline mutation queue and replay engine for mobile or edge workflows.

units.description: Shop analytics + offline queue engines — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Integration routes + cost analytics alignment
entry_conditions: Connectors, analytics, and offline queue engines are available.
The integrations route surface and actual cost rollups are ready for extension.
exit_conditions: Integration routes expose sync health, replay queue state, and intelligence surfaces.
Actual cost rollups align with the new analytics fabric and external sync model.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Revert the integration route and actual-cost updates and continue with the older analytics path.

steps.instruction: Extend integration routes to expose sync status, queue replay, connector health, and analytics summary data.
Align actual-cost rollups so the same data can feed ERP sync, accounting sync, and business intelligence consumers.
steps.validation: Cost and variance data remain consistent across local state, sync payloads, and analytics outputs.

deliverables.description: Integration route surface for connector health, replay queue, and sync controls.
Actual-cost alignment with sync and analytics fabrics.

units.description: Integration routes + cost analytics alignment — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

custom_checks: Bidirectional sync preserves canonical identifiers and conflict provenance.
Offline replay cannot duplicate labor, quantity, or traveler updates.

phases.title: Forge-Triple Sync Operations
phases.description: Expose sync operations through command docs and protect connectors with credential and end-to-end validation.

units.title: Sync health command + sync ops template
entry_conditions: Connector health, replay queues, and analytics endpoints are defined.
Operators need a standard way to inspect sync status and failure modes.
exit_conditions: A sync health command doc exists for connector status, retries, and replay controls.
A forge-triple sync template exists for future connector or analytics work.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Remove the command and template docs and use raw integration notes instead.

steps.instruction: Write a sync health command doc covering connector status, replay queues, conflict inspection, and retry actions.
Create a sync-ops template that future milestones can reuse for connector prompts, payloads, and health indicators.
steps.validation: The command doc and template share the same connector and replay vocabulary.

deliverables.description: Slash-command style guide for connector health, replay, and sync diagnostics.
Forge-triple template for sync operations, replay, and connector health prompts.

units.description: Sync health command + sync ops template — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Credential guard + end-to-end sync proof
entry_conditions: The connector surfaces and sync command docs exist.
Credential storage and replay policies are defined.
exit_conditions: A credential guard validates connector readiness and blocks unsafe sync attempts.
End-to-end tests prove sync, replay, and analytics propagation work together.
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
units.rollback: Disable the new guard or E2E suite if connector instability causes false failures.

steps.instruction: Add a connector credential guard that validates readiness, secret presence, and replay preconditions before sync starts.
Build an end-to-end sync proof for connector ingestion, replay, conflict handling, and analytics update propagation.
steps.validation: The E2E suite proves connectors, offline queue, and analytics stay coherent through retries.

deliverables.description: Guardrail for connector credential and sync readiness checks.
End-to-end proof for connector sync, replay queue, and analytics propagation.

units.description: Credential guard + end-to-end sync proof — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

custom_checks: Sync commands map directly to live connector and queue surfaces.
E2E coverage proves conflict-aware replay and analytics propagation.

tool_map.purpose: Implement connectors, analytics, command docs, and tests
Map sync contracts across routes and connectors
Review connector safety and end-to-end sync evidence

existing_leverage.usage: ERP mapping baseline for E2 alignment
Existing integration route surface for sync health expansion
Live propagation of sync-driven state updates
